about: Valium (diazepam) 5 mg, 10 tablets, is supplied once in May 2026 by brand name only. Diazepam has no daily dose limit in the list.
Lorazepam 1 mg, 30 tablets, 'Take TWO tablets at night' (2 mg a day, above the 1 mg a day limit for lorazepam) is supplied once in February 2026, in the middle of a 16-month history.
Lorazepam 1 mg, 20 tablets, 'Take ONE tablet at night' is 1 mg a day, which is not above the 1 mg a day limit for lorazepam, so it must not flag.
